introduction: Wyoming Kid Care CHIP provides health coverage for eligible uninsured children and teens whose families do not qualify for Medicaid. The state accepts a shared Medicaid and CHIP application.

who: Wyoming children and teens through age 18 meeting income and other CHIP requirements.
Applicants are assessed for Medicaid; tell customer service about existing insurance and status circumstances.
sections.get: Health, vision, dental and prescription coverage. Preventive services are listed without copays, while other costs depend on the approved plan.
sections.docs: Prepare child identity, household income, residence and other insurance information. Keep any verification request and ask what alternatives are accepted for unavailable records.
sections.apply:
1. Apply or renew through the state portal linked from the Kid Care CHIP page.
  2. For a telephone application call 855-294-2127.
  3. Paper applications can be returned using the current state application page’s instructions.
  4. Ask customer service to confirm the address before mailing if state pages disagree.
sections.after: Respond to renewal texts and mailed forms. Complete and return the renewal by its deadline and update contact information promptly. Read the coverage decision, plan costs and participating providers. Enrollment and renewal do not require paying an application fee.
